project_extensions.scope: Collider Monte Carlo native Delphes ROOT stage: data tiers, exact card, reconstruction and truth response.

acceptance_criteria: Exact parent 128-event HepMC and native stock ILD card with wrapper seed only.
Native ROOT truth-muon records stable, opposite-sign and matched event-by-event; checked central direction and charge identity.
Central efficiency 0.9405 to within five binomial standard errors; independent standardized log-pT mean within five standard errors, RMS 0.65 to 1.35.
Separate seeded physics payload replay identical, wrong source hash rejected.
